boundaries.name: scenario-success-is-not-generic-toolkit
boundaries.rule: A scenario-specific command, path, answer protocol, secret encoding, project file, or author workflow cannot be advertised as a generic toolkit contract until relative paths, prompts, scenario contracts, discoverable skill entry points, and clean-install acceptance tests exist.

boundaries.name: answer-and-prohibited-content-custody
boundaries.rule: Plaintext answers, spoilers, hidden-layer material, and prohibited lyric text must not enter tracked solver-facing artifacts. Publishing requires encoded or ignored answer custody plus scrub and known-answer checks.

boundaries.name: mechanism-quality-is-not-extraction-proof
boundaries.rule: A clever puzzle mechanism, theme, or brief cannot advance unless answer words are feasible against world or source data and extraction is verified character by character before authoring and blind tests.
